description: This Scala source file defines the ArrowUtils object, which provides utility functions for converting between Spark DataTypes and Apache Arrow types and schemas, including support for spatial types and handling of complex nested structures.

methods.name: toArrowType
methods.description: Converts Spark DataType to corresponding ArrowType, considering timezone and large variable types.

methods.name: fromArrowType
methods.description: Converts ArrowType back to Spark DataType.

methods.name: toArrowField
methods.description: Creates an Arrow Field from Spark DataType, including support for nested and spatial types.

methods.name: isVariantField
methods.description: Checks if a given Arrow Field represents a Variant type.

methods.name: isGeometryField
methods.description: Checks if a given Arrow Field represents a Geometry type.

methods.name: isGeographyField
methods.description: Checks if a given Arrow Field represents a Geography type.

methods.name: fromArrowField
methods.description: Converts an Arrow Field to Spark DataType, handling nested and spatial types.

methods.name: toArrowSchema
methods.description: Converts Spark StructType schema to Arrow Schema, considering timezone and large variable types.

methods.name: fromArrowSchema
methods.description: Converts Arrow Schema back to Spark StructType schema.

methods.name: deduplicateFieldNames
methods.description: Ensures unique field names within schemas, optionally erroring on duplicates.
